title: SideEffect
description: One declared (and optionally committed) irreversible agent action. Closes #11. Producers MUST call declare_side_effect BEFORE dispatching so the declaration is recorded even if the run is killed mid-step; commit_side_effect lands the observed result after dispatch returns.

side_effect_id.description: Stable id for this declared effect; usually a UUID.

resource.description: What the agent is acting on. Conventionally `<system>:<id>` (e.g. `stripe:cus_x`, `gmail:msg_y`).

action.description: Action verb (form_submit, payment_create, email_send, …). Free-form so adapters can extend.

compensation_handle.description: Adapter-defined handle a compensating workflow can use to undo this effect.

provenance.description: Who declared this effect. `sdk_declared` = explicit call; `adapter_inferred` = adapter on_side_effect hook; `human_declared` = operator override.

status.description: Lifecycle: declare → intent_only; commit → committed; kill between → aborted.
